item.description: The artifact loading mechanism fails for non-base Pydantic models (like NonUserNonBaseModelClass) when using custom loaders. The system doesn't properly handle the loading of complex artifact types that don't inherit from BaseModel but have custom serialization methods.
item.contract: When an artifact is annotated with a custom loader function for a non-base Pydantic model, the system must properly invoke that loader function to deserialize the artifact content into the expected object type.

item.description: The artifact path resolution and directory creation logic fails when artifacts are expected to be written to paths that are directories instead of files, causing "Is a directory" errors.
item.contract: When saving artifacts, the system must ensure that directory paths are properly created and that file artifacts are written to the correct file paths, not directories.
item.acceptance: tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_input_artifacts[pydantic io artifact input variations-1], tests/test_runner.py::test_script_annotations_artifacts_no_name_or_path[tests.script_runner.artifact_loaders:file_loader_default_path-an_artifact-Hello there!-Hello there!]

item.description: Pydantic validation type checking fails for complex type annotations like typing.Dict[str, str] and typing.List[str], incorrectly rejecting valid outputs due to strict type checking.
item.contract: When validating function outputs against annotated return types, the system must properly handle generic types like typing.Dict[str, str] and typing.List[str] to accept their corresponding Python objects (dict and list respectively).

item.description: The system fails to properly handle artifact path construction for input artifacts, particularly when they lack explicit paths, causing FileNotFoundError when attempting to read artifact files.
item.contract: When loading input artifacts without explicit paths, the system must correctly construct the artifact file path using the default input directory and ensure that the file exists before attempting to read it.

item.description: Missing or incorrect module exports cause AttributeError when running certain test cases, such as test_hera_output[typed_script_input_output] which fails with "module has no attribute 'w'
item.contract: Module imports and exports must be properly configured so that all referenced modules and functions are accessible during runtime execution.
